name: Pendulum Robotics
long_description:
We design and manufacture high-mix drone motors and robotic actuators in LA.

DJI, Apple, and Ford don't settle for OTS components. Likewise, the teams that win the Western robotics market will build seamless machines from tightly integrated software and hardware. 

Pendulum Robotics designs motors and actuators around your robot's unique form factor and mission - then we rapidly bring them to life with proprietary software and tooling geared for high-mix machining and assembly. Our first factory in LA can create thousands of motors per month up to 200mm OD.

We're doing for motion components what 3D printing has done for structural components. Hardware teams that can build and iterate at the speed of software will create elegant, reliable, ROI-positive robots and win massive markets.
one_liner: Quick-turn, purpose-built motors & actuators for all
